items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I met Benny Bailey. But he wasn't playing like he can play now... when I first met him, he was like a timid young fellow.

ctx.x: They just get paid, you know. I said, 'Well, what the fuck happens to me?' I'm here and I can't stay with this group, and have nothing happen. So I started writing for a cat named Bailey. He had a sextet.
